caveats: Points table was reverse-engineered from the Season 2 start.gg league and reproduces all 26 league totals exactly. It is not published by Levels.
Placements of 25th and below were never held by a scoring player, so their value is extrapolated as 0 rather than proven.
No attendance points: entrants with no standing score 0. Verified for Season 2 only.
Season 1 and Season 3 were not run as start.gg leagues, so their points here are computed, not reconciled against start.gg.
Unlinked walk-in players are keyed on a normalised gamertag, which merges casing variants like f2/F2 but cannot merge genuinely different spellings.
Season 3 weeks 3-5 are scheduled placeholders, not scraped events. The snapshot ends on 23 August 2026, so without them the app would have no upcoming weeklies to show.

Team names and tags are real, and rosters are derived from the sponsor prefixes players actually used in their entrant names. Join dates are invented, as is Rahil moving from Do Not Compete to Man Like mid-Season 2 — that transfer exists to show that points stay with the team a player was on at the time.
scope: all tournaments owned by start.gg user 3073295 (Levels)
scoring_rule: An event scores if its own name or its tournament's name mentions a season.
